observations: Photo 0: silver and black retro mirrorless camera body, front view with a Nikon Z mount body cap fitted. 'Nikon' on the prism housing and 'Z fc' on the top plate are readable.

Photo 1: top and lens view; 'Z fc' and 'Nikon' readable on the body, ISO dial and shutter speed dial visible, a black manual focus prime lens fitted with 'TTArtisan' on the barrel and a distance scale.

Photo 2: top view of the body with the lens fitted, plus a Nikon branded rechargeable Li-ion battery, a Nikon branded battery charger, a body cap, a rear lens cap, and a front lens cap reading 'TTArtisan APS-C 25mm f2.0'.
The fitted lens is a third party TTArtisan 25mm f/2 manual lens, not a Nikon Z lens.
Body looks clean in all three photos: leatherette intact, dials crisp, no dents or heavy scratches visible at this resolution.
The camera is never shown switched on; the rear flip screen, sensor, card slot, battery door and underside are not shown.
Every photo carries the watermark 'OYIBEST GLOBAL RESOURCES', which suggests a dealer's photos.

identity.kind: mirrorless camera body with a manual prime lens
identity.model: Z fc (with TTArtisan 25mm f/2 APS-C lens)
read_from: photo 0 top plate 'Z fc' and prism 'Nikon'

claims.claim: Nikon Z fc, retro styled mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' on the body.
A spec sheet line; consistent with the model read in photo 0 but not shown by any photo.
No shutter count screenshot or file metadata provided.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: No photo looking through the lens against a light; the lens is a TTArtisan third party lens, photo 1 and photo 2.
Photo 2 shows a Nikon branded battery and a Nikon branded charger; whether they are genuine Nikon parts needs the agent to check.
Repair history cannot be shown in photos.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function: it is never shown switched on.
risks.proof: A clip switching it on, showing the rear screen and viewfinder live, and taking a shot.
A full resolution sample photo straight from the camera, or a screenshot of the shutter count read from that file.

risks.risk: Rear flip screen cracked, scratched or with a broken hinge.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear screen lit, plus a clip flipping it out and rotating it.

risks.risk: Sensor scratched, dusty or with dead pixels.
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with the body cap off, and a sample shot of a plain bright wall at a small aperture.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as sensor needing cleaning or repair.

risks.risk: Lens has fungus, haze or scratches.
risks.proof: Photo looking through the lens against a bright light from both ends.

risks.risk: Card slot, battery door or ports damaged, or body is stolen.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside with the battery door open, the card slot, the ports, and the serial number plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as with door or port faults; serial checked by the agent before payment.

risks.risk: Buyer might assume a Nikon Z kit lens; the lens supplied is a third party manual TTArtisan 25mm.
risks.proof: Already settled by photo 2 lens cap and photo 1 barrel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as Z fc body with a TTArtisan 25mm f/2 lens, not with a Nikon lens.

proof_requests: A clip powering the camera on, showing the rear screen and viewfinder live, and taking a shot.
A screenshot of the shutter count read from a fresh full resolution photo.
Photos of the rear screen lit and flipped out, and of the underside with serial plate, battery door and card slot.
Photo of the sensor with the body cap off and a sample shot of a plain bright wall.
Photo through the lens against a bright light.
response.reason: Photos 0 and 1 read Nikon Z fc and photo 2 shows a TTArtisan 25mm f/2 lens with a Nikon battery and charger, so it can be priced at worst case. It is never shown switched on and the shutter count and lens clarity are unproven, so it is priced as not working until a power on clip and shutter count are sent.
